name: exasync-plugins
description: Small, dependency-free Claude Code plugins from running an autonomous AI company: a plain-text email gate, a decision precedent memory, and a usage guard hook.

plugins.name: email-format-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic pre-send gate for customer-facing email: no long dashes, no formatting in the body, no unresolved placeholders, no team salutations, no double sign-offs. Also scans pipeline code for hard-wired violations.

plugins.name: decision-precedent
plugins.description: Never ask the same question twice: search stored decisions before asking a human, store the answer with rationale, and log whether a precedent was applied. Local JSON store, no cloud required.

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Hook that shows your subscription usage in every turn and blocks expensive commands once a threshold is reached, so a long-running session hands over cleanly instead of hitting the wall.
